response.original_title: Aryton Senna - Beyond The Speed of Sound
response.overview: This documentary explores the life and career of the legendary driver, focusing on the dedication, skill, and intense competitive spirit required to succeed in Formula One. It examines the technical aspects of racing and the complex relationships with rivals and teams, providing a deep look into the world of top-tier motorsport.
